references.text: Moses exhorts the people to keep the commandments so that they may live and enter the land
The promise of living long in the land by walking in the Lord's ways
The commandments are to be kept so that it may go well with them and they may become numerous in the land
Keep all the commandments to be strong and take possession of the land as the Lord promised the fathers
By keeping the Lord's commandments, the people shall live and become numerous, and the Lord will bless them in the land
Promise of blessing by listening to the Lord's voice and keeping His commandments
The one who keeps the Lord's laws and commandments shall live by them
God's oath to Abraham to bless his descendants and give them the land
The Lord confirms the oath He swore to Abraham to give the land to his offspring
Ezekiel refers to the commandments that give life to the one who keeps them
Jesus quotes from Deuteronomy 8 when He is tempted in the wilderness
Jesus teaches that whoever wants to enter into life must keep the commandments
Paulus quotes about the righteousness of the law: the one who does these things shall live by them
